import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 256;
    static final int MAXT = 64;
    static final int MAXE = MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, f, c, nx;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int u, int v, int f, int c, int nx) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.nx = nx;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        private Edge[] e = new Edge[MAXE];
        private int n, m, src, dst;
        private int[] head = new int[MAXN];
        private int[] work = new int[MAXN];
        private int[] d = new int[MAXN];

        private boolean bfs() {
            int[] q = new int[MAXN];
            int le = 0, ri = 0;
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            q[ri++] = src;
            d[src] = 0;
            while (le < ri) {
                for (int k = q[le++], i = head[k]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {
                    if (e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == -1) {
                        d[e[i].v] = d[k] + 1;
                        q[ri++] = e[i].v;
                    }
                }
            }
            return (d[dst] != -1);
        }

        private int dfs(int u, int f) {
            if (u == dst)
                return f;
            int minf;
            for (int i = work[u]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {
                work[u] = e[i].nx;
                if (e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == d[u] + 1) {
                    minf = dfs(e[i].v, Math.min(f, e[i].c - e[i].f));
                    if (minf > 0) {
                        e[i].f += minf;
                        e[i ^ 1].f -= minf;
                        return minf;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public void init(int n, int src, int dst) {
            this.n = n;
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            m = 0;
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        }

        public void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            e[m] = new Edge(u, v, 0, c, head[u]);
            head[u] = m++;
            e[m] = new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]);
            head[v] = m++;
        }

        public int maxFlow() {
            int ret = 0, delta;
            while (bfs()) {
                System.arraycopy(head, 0, work, 0, n);
                while (true) {
                    delta = dfs(src, INF);
                    if (delta == 0)
                        break;
                    ret += delta;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX = 12;
    static int n, t, zx, zy;
    static char[][] smp = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] cmp = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] work = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] vis = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * n + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return n * n + i * n + j; }
    static int S() { return n * n * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    static class qNode {
        int x, y, t, type;
        qNode() {}
        qNode(int x, int y, int t, int type) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.t = t;
            this.type = type;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<qNode> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new qNode(sx, sy, 0, 0));
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        q.add(new qNode(zx, zy, 0, 1));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            qNode u = q.poll();
            int nx, ny;
            if (u.t == t)
                break;
            if (u.type == 0 && Character.isLetter(work[u.x][u.y]))
                continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                nx = u.x + dx[i];
                ny = u.y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n) {
                    if (u.type == 0 && vis[nx][ny] == 0 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                        q.add(new qNode(nx, ny, u.t + 1, 0));
                    } else if (u.type == 1 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        work[nx][ny] = 'Z';
                        q.add(new qNode(nx, ny, u.t + 1, 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
            String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
            n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            t = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
            
            Dinic dinic = new Dinic();
            dinic.init(N(), S(), T());
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                String s = br.readLine().trim();
                smp[i] = s.toCharArray();
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) && smp[i][j] > '0')
                        dinic.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), smp[i][j] - '0');
                    else if (smp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                        zx = i;
                        zy = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                String s = br.readLine().trim();
                cmp[i] = s.toCharArray();
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (Character.isDigit(cmp[i][j]) && cmp[i][j] > '0')
                        dinic.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), cmp[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (!Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) || smp[i][j] <= '0')
                        continue;
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX; x++)
                        Arrays.fill(vis[x], 0);
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX; x++)
                        System.arraycopy(smp[x], 0, work[x], 0, MAX);
                    bfs(i, j);
                    for (int xi = 0; xi < n; ++xi) {
                        for (int yi = 0; yi < n; ++yi) {
                            if (!Character.isDigit(cmp[xi][yi]) || cmp[xi][yi] <= '0')
                                continue;
                            if (vis[xi][yi] == 1) {
                                dinic.addEdge(X(i, j), Y(xi, yi), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow());
        }
    }
}
